objective.title: Qualify root residual and Simpson regularity audit limits

declared.summary: Qualify explicit residual and regularity audits over bounded Math root solving and Simpson integration. Recover a compiled missing-API RED, pass 50 GREENs, 44 retained C02 T1 and 108 retained C01 tests, plus two regressions. SHA-qualify real local analysis preview.4 with two independent source-free eight-probe NuGet consumers. Close T2 and C02 only; W01/M6, rigorous error theorems, public NuGet and downstream adoption remain open.
declared.value: Prevent sign-jump or width-only bisection results from masquerading as small-residual roots; refuse Simpson observations without explicitly declared, unverified caller smoothness. Preserve existing numerical and curve APIs with typed nonpartial failures.
debtChanges: Observe one compiled missing-public-audit-API RED before staging new Math numerical source, then recover it alongside 50 independent GREEN scientific tests.
Refuse width-only bisection success when observed function residual exceeds caller tolerance, including discontinuous sign-jump and coarse-width adversarial cases.

Use typed no-partial-output refusal for untrusted callbacks, nonfinite inputs, cancellation, missing brackets, budget and nonconvergence.
Retain the 44 qualified C02 T1 root/quadrature tests and all 108 C01 interpolation, spline and regression oracles unchanged.
Preserve BCL-only net10 library boundaries and run two relevant Math regression projects without routine full-solution certification.
Inspect one actual locally packed 1.1.0-preview.4 NuGet archive and prove identical bytes in new and retained distinct eight-probe source-free consumers.
Close C02-T2 R/G/V, T2 and phase C02 only; retain M6-W01 and M6 in progress, with C03 and public/downstream adoption unqualified.
